title: Israel's Political Instability

questions.question: When I would heal Israel, the iniquity of whom is revealed?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:1 (ESV): "When I would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is revealed,"

questions.question: They are all adulterers; they are like a heated what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:4 (ESV): "They are all adulterers; they are like a heated oven"

questions.question: Ephraim mixes himself with the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:8 (ESV): "Ephraim is a cake not turned."

questions.question: Strangers devour his strength, and he knows it not; gray hairs are sprinkled upon him, and he knows it not.
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:9 (ESV): "Strangers devour his strength, and he knows it not; gray hairs are sprinkled upon him, and he knows it not."

questions.question: Ephraim is like a dove, silly and without what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:11 (ESV): "Ephraim is like a dove, silly and without sense,"

questions.question: They do not say to themselves, "The Lord remembers all our..."?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:2 (ESV): "But they do not consider that I remember all their evil."

questions.question: On the day of our king, the princes became sick with the heat of what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:5 (ESV): "On the day of our king, the princes became sick with the heat of wine;"

questions.question: For like an oven their hearts burn with what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:6 (ESV): "For with their hearts like an oven they approach their intrigue;"

questions.question: All of them are hot as an oven, and they devour their what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:7 (ESV): "All of them are hot as an oven, and they devour their rulers."

questions.question: Woe to them, for they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, for they have done what against me?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:13 (ESV): "Destruction to them, for they have rebelled against me!"

questions.question: They do not cry to me from the heart, but they wail upon their what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:14 (ESV): "They do not cry to me from the heart, but they wail upon their beds;"

questions.question: For grain and wine they gash themselves; they what against me?
They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a treacherous what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:16 (ESV): "They are like a treacherous bow;"

questions.question: Their princes shall fall by the sword because of the insolence of their what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:16 (ESV): "their princes shall fall by the sword because of the insolence of their tongue."

questions.question: I would redeem them, but they speak what against me?
questions.explanation: Hosea 7:13 (ESV): "I would redeem them, but they speak lies against me."

key_verse_text: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they do not return to the Lord their God, nor seek him, for all this.
